description: This file defines a React component 'Grid' for displaying session information and a 'SessionChip' component for individual session interactions within a developer tools interface, including session management and screencast display.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: React functional component for displaying a grid of sessions grouped by workspace.

classes.name: SessionChip
classes.description: React functional component representing an individual session with controls for closing or deleting session data, and displaying screencast.

methods.name: toggleWorkspace
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of a workspace group.
